partners.title: Partner with AJSEE | Our partners
partners.description: Reach new audiences with AJSEE. Meet our partners and explore ways to work together on tickets, accommodation and experiences.
partners.ogDescription: Reach new audiences with AJSEE. Meet our partners and explore ways to work together on tickets, accommodation and experiences.

footer-company-info: AJSEE® is operated by AJSEE LTD, registered in England and Wales under company number 17105762. Registered office: 71-75 Shelton Street, Covent Garden, London, WC2H 9JQ.
partner-intro-line1: People come to AJSEE to discover concerts, theatre and other experiences.
partner-intro-line2: They find your offer with us and complete their purchase or booking directly with you.
partner-roster-ticketmaster: Tickets for concerts, sport and other live events.
partner-roster-smsticket: Tickets for cultural events in Czechia.
partner-roster-todaytix: Musicals and theatre in London’s West End.
partner-roster-colosseumticket: Tickets for theatre, concerts and other cultural events.
partner-option-1-text: We’ll include your events in our listings and recommendations. Visitors will discover them on AJSEE and buy tickets directly from you.
partner-option-2-text: We’ll recommend your accommodation and other services alongside suitable events. Visitors can plan the whole trip more easily and book directly with you.
partner-option-3-text: We’ll feature your offer in an article, a guide or our recommendations. We’ll give readers a sense of what they can experience with you and why it’s worth a visit.
partner-case-text: London musicals have their own page on AJSEE. Visitors explore the shows, then continue to the AJSEE × TodayTix partner ticket site to buy tickets.
partner-process-step-1-text: A few lines about what you offer and how you’d like to work with AJSEE are enough.
partner-process-step-2-text: Together, we’ll decide how to present your offer on AJSEE and agree on the terms of our partnership.
partner-process-step-3-text: We’ll feature your offer on AJSEE. We’ll regularly discuss the results with you and explore how to develop the partnership.
partner-contact-intro: Send us a few lines about your offer. We’d be happy to discuss how we could work together.
partner-placeholder-message: What do you offer, and what partnership do you have in mind?
partner-success-msg: Thank you for your message. We’ll be in touch.
partner-error-msg: Your message could not be sent. Please try again or email partners@ajsee.cz.
partner-error-company: Enter your company or brand name.
